no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Finch Therapeutics discontinued all clinical development in early 2023 (laid off ~95% of staff and terminated PRISM4 Phase 3 microbiome study of CP101 for recurrent C. difficile infection). The company subsequently delisted from Nasdaq and deregistered with the SEC in October 2024, and as of March 2026 is conducting a Chapter 11 Section 363 process to sell its ~160-patent microbiome IP portfolio and the $25M Ferring/Rebiotix patent-infringement verdict. There is no active P1/P2/P3 program; the entity is effectively in wind-down/asset-sale mode.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 3 PRISM4 study discontinued early 2023 amid 95% workforce reduction; program terminated

blockers: Company in Chapter 11 wind-down / asset-sale; no current pipeline; FY2023 10-K is most recent available SEC filing.
